name: Onn Hafiz Ghazi
_note: M2 state-executive cohort (Phase 2: all 13 state heads). Menteri Besar of Johor since 15 Mar 2022. Added as a BN-aligned peninsular executive to break the coalition-vs-state-capacity confound that kept the sub-national-executive class disclosed (PN poorer states vs GPS/GRS Borneo). NO coder panel yet at file creation; Layer B carries provisional anchors pending the blind panel (minCodersToScore=3). Citations search-corroborated, full text not opened (fetch restriction); reconfirm against primary sources. TENURE CAVEAT: the Johor assembly was dissolved 1 Jun 2026; he is caretaker MB pending a state election. Scored on his 2022-2026 record. 3R: B5 left unscored (his royalty-related conduct is defensive, not a breach).

metrics.justification: No corruption charge, MACC investigation, or court matter against Onn Hafiz personally is on record; he appeared only as a witness in an unrelated 2019 trial. As MB he required incoming state exco members to declare assets and undergo MACC and police vetting. Recorded as the subject's own status: none on record.

citation.title: New Johor excos must declare assets, get vetted by MACC, cops - sultan

metrics.justification: During the March 2025 Johor floods (about 13,089 people from 3,749 families evacuated across six districts) his administration coordinated relief and directed the drainage department to expedite mitigation works, then announced RM11.2 million in cash aid, RM3,000 to each affected household head (26 Mar 2025). Documented relief response with named allocations (anchor 3).

citation.title: Johor govt to hand out RM11.2mil cash aid to flood-hit households

metrics.justification: The Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JS-SEZ) intergovernmental agreement was signed on 7 Jan 2025, building on a Jan 2024 MOU, with a special 5% corporate tax rate for qualifying investors; he was a signing principal and the zone is his administration's flagship economic instrument. A delivered, dated intergovernmental agreement (anchor 3).

citation.title: Signing of Johor-Singapore SEZ agreement to boost economy

metrics.justification: On 26 Nov 2025 Malaysia and Singapore established the Johor-Singapore Cooperation Ministerial Committee (JSCMC), a permanent bilateral mechanism replacing the older Iskandar joint committee, giving strategic direction to JS-SEZ and transport cooperation, with him attending as a state principal. Documented cross-jurisdiction institution-building (anchor 3).

citation.title: JMCIM out, JSCMC in: Malaysia and Singapore revamp bilateral cooperation over Iskandar

metrics.justification: Having been the first UMNO leader to publicly call for party president Ahmad Zahid Hamidi to resign after GE15, he later reversed course and apologised (disclosed 25 May 2026), stating on the record that he had overstepped. A documented, dated reversal of his own stated position (anchor 3).

citation.title: I apologised to Zahid after calling for his resignation, says Onn Hafiz
